newsitem.title: BELARUS: Belarus court halts Lukashenko impeachment case.
newsitem.headline: Belarus court halts Lukashenko impeachment case.

text.p: The Belarussian constitutional court on Tuesday halted an impeachment case brought by parliament last week against President Alexander Lukashenko for violating the constitution, a spokesman said.
Court spokesman Oleg Moskalyov told Reuters: "The constitutional court has just decided to stop the case concerning the president of Belarus violating the constitution.
The decision came as no surprise after a majority of deputies loyal to Lukashenko formed a breakaway parliament and voted to withdraw the impeachment case.
A source close to the court said only 63 signatures from deputies remained on the impeachment papers, seven fewer than the minimum required for the case to continue.
